add_decision_rules.name: stopped_or_idle_profile_sequence
add_decision_rules.condition: farm status and state indicate the profile is stopped or idle and no container or registry error is present
add_decision_rules.outcome: use farm_state_get, farm_profile, farm_state_set, and farm_profile_start in sequence

add_decision_rules.name: registry_or_image_pull_failure
add_decision_rules.condition: the failure involves container image pull, registry authentication, or a missing container-registry capability
add_decision_rules.outcome: require the container-registry capability before attempting further farm profile start

add_heuristics.condition: the error suggests a container, registry, or image pull problem
add_heuristics.action: avoid blind retries; route to the container-registry capability if it is not available
